q: Uniform recurrence (almost periodicity in the sense of Bohr-Birkhoff) for a point x in a topological dynamical system means: for every ε > 0, the set of return times {n : d(T^nx,x) < ε} is:
exp: Uniform recurrence = syndetic return times: {n : T^nx ∈ U} has bounded gaps for every open U ∋ x. This is equivalent to x being a minimal point (its orbit closure is minimal). Syndetic return times imply the system is 'almost periodic' in the topological sense.
